g.text: outdated-inject-py
A Python injector that loads CPython into SoF and runs the minimise-maximise focus watcher inside the game process.
Entry points
Core
State
External
`launch.sh` · sets `PYTHONPATH` to a mayhem checkout, runs `test.py` with two args
`test.py script procname` · the injector, must run on Windows only
`pythonXY.dll` · found for the host interpreter, must match the game's bitness
find the game · `EnumProcesses` in a growing array, match the image basename exactly
open the process · mayhem `WindowsProcess(pid)`, retried every second until it appears
load CPython · `load_library` on the dll, then compute remote addresses
resolve remote addresses · remote base plus the local export offset
start Python · remote thread on `Py_InitializeEx`, joined before anything else
write the stub · `runpy.run_path` with run name `__mayhem__`, then `ExitThread`
hand over · named pipe `mayhem`, write `640x480`, close, join the thread
payload starts · reads the desktop size file, opens the pipe as a client
focus watcher · same hooks and same two branches as `minimise-maximise`
`sofplus/data/mm_desktop_res` · desktop size the payload restores to
`sofplus/data/mm_res` · game size, written by an addon this repo does not ship
payload globals · `sofId`, `resizedDesktop` flag, `origResSof`
window calls · `EnumWindows`, `GetWindowPlacement`, `ShowWindow`
display calls · `GetSystemMetrics`, `ChangeDisplaySettings`, `DEVMODEType`
SoF.exe · the injected host, owns the window titled `SoF`
mayhem · process handles, `WriteFile` and thread calls, Python stub template
a handle per candidate pid
a handle is required first
the module base comes back from the load
two export addresses, computed, not searched
the interpreter must exist before code runs
the stub connects back or the injector waits
the server writes, the payload reads once
payload owns the hook from here
the launcher only picks the script and the process
one file in, one file out, both under the game's user folder
the game is the host and Windows is the trigger
